basis: neutral default; no user writing samples supplied
sentence_length: Prefer 12–25 words; allow longer sentences for necessary technical precision.
directness: Lead with action and concrete object; avoid throat clearing.
paragraphs: One idea per paragraph, two to four sentences in a letter.
technical_detail: Name the tool, its actual use and supported outcome.
confidence: Preserve uncertainty, estimates and scope; avoid inflated adjectives.
